g.text: │ --scopes <str> Google: comma-separated limited scopes. Default: Gmail, Calendar, Drive │
Google Calendar events and Meet links. Bare co gcalendar lists events.
│ list List primary-calendar events with stable event IDs (not row numbers). │
│ read Read one event by ID. │
│ meetings Read upcoming events that have attendees. │
│ free Find primary-calendar free slots between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. │
│ create Create an event. Use ISO timestamps with offsets; naive times mean UTC. │
│ meet Create a Calendar event with a Google Meet conference request. │
│ update Update supplied nonempty fields; other fields are preserved. │
│ delete Delete an event by stable ID, never by a listing number. │
YouTube Data API using your saved Google login. Writes preview by default.
│ channel Read a channel and its uploads playlist ID. │
│ list List recent uploads; numbers refer to this exact listing. │
│ video Read one video's metadata and returned counts. │
│ put Preview locally; upload only with the current plan's --confirm digest. │
│ update Preview title/description edits without changing privacy or other parts. │
Connect once with co auth google, then use the saved Google login like co gmail. Tokens refresh
automatically through the existing Google OAuth broker. YouTube operations use the official Data
API. Uploads default to private; unverified API projects can force private visibility. --confirm
